title: Brain Battle Q
overview:
Prizes awarded to the champion of the quiz championship!!

Take on the "Sega Saturn Quiz Championship" held in the futuristic city of Clefland. Face powerful rival characters in buzzer quizzes and aim for victory!! Once you've won, it's on to a score battle with gamers nationwide in the "National Quiz Championship"! A game with the ultimate RPG sense of accomplishment, where you can receive prizes for placing or as lucky awards!!

クイズ選手権の覇者に賞品を授与！！

未来都市クレフランドで開催される、「セガサターンクイズ選手権」に挑戦。強力な敵キャラと早押しクイズで対戦し、優勝を狙ってくれ！！優勝したら、次は全国のゲーマーとスコア勝負、「クイズ全国選手権」に挑戦だ！入賞やラッキー賞の賞品がもらえる、RPG最高の達成感ゲーム！！
